verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no capability for scheduling recurring jobs or workflows. Reminders are listed without any mention of recurrence, and a one-off reminder is not a recurring schedule. Recipes are described as setting up 'automations and integrations', and the API lets external services trigger Poke on events, but neither describes time-based recurring execution, so both are adjacent features rather than this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Reminders - Set and manage reminders naturally
All new and existing users can use Poke Recipes to easily set up automations and integrations, as well as share their set-ups with others.
Services like GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, or monitoring tools can trigger Poke when something happens.
